name: Universal MCP Server
description: Provides comprehensive MCP functionality with GGUF model integration, enabling resource management, dynamic tool execution, web data fetching, file operations, and system information retrieval. Supports automatic model detection from LM Studio with built-in security measures and extensible tool plugins.
